# CanWinBuddy

> AI quiz generator that turns any text, document, or image into validated multiple-choice questions and exports them to Blooket, Gimkit, Gimkit 2, and Kahoot.

CanWinBuddy uses AI to generate quiz questions and validates every question against the original source material before saving. Users can play sets in-app or copy/export them in the exact format required by popular quiz platforms.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in to generate and manage quiz sets.
